1: // Neon Runner – simple endless runner on a canvas with id="game"
2: // Click or tap to make the orb jump. Avoid moving barriers.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return; // no canvas present
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9: // Resize canvas to fill its container
10:   // Audio setup
11:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
16:     osc.type = 'sine';
17:     osc.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
21:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur / 1000);
23:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur / 1000);
24:   }
25:   function playJump() { playTone(300, 100); }
26:   function playHit() { playTone(80, 300); }
27:   function resize() {
28:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
29:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
30:     generateStars();
31:   }
32:   }
33:   function resize() {
34:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
35:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
36:     generateStars();
37:   }
38:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
39:   resize();
40: 
41:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
42:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
43:   const PLAYER_RADIUS = 12;
44:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 20;
45:   const OBSTACLE_GAP = 80; // vertical gap for the orb to pass
46:   const SPEED = 4;
47: 
48:   const player = { x: 60, y: canvas.height / 2, vy: 0, alive: true };
49:   let obstacles = [];
50:   let spawnTimer = 0;
51:   let score = 0;
52:   let lastTime = 0;
53: 
54:   function reset() {
55:     player.y = canvas.height / 2;
56:     player.vy = 0;
57:     player.alive = true;
58:     obstacles = [];
59:     spawnTimer = 0;
60:     score = 0;
61:     lastTime = performance.now();
62:   }
63: 
64:   function jump() {
65:     // ensure audio context is running
66:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
67:     if (!player.alive) {
68:       reset();
69:       return;
70:     }
71:     player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
72:     playJump();
73:   }
74: 
75:   canvas.addEventListener('click', jump);
76:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); jump(); }, { passive: false });
77: 
78:   function spawnObstacle() {
79:     const gapY = Math.random() * (canvas.height - OBSTACLE_GAP - 40) + 20;
80:     // top rect
81:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y: 0, w: OBSTACLE_WIDTH, h: gapY });
82:     // bottom rect
83:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y: gapY + OBSTACLE_GAP, w: OBSTACLE_WIDTH, h: canvas.height - (gapY + OBSTACLE_GAP) });
84:   }
85: 
86:   function update(dt) {
87:     if (!player.alive) return;
88:     // player physics
89:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
90:     player.y += player.vy;
91:     // floor/ceiling check
92:     if (player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS > canvas.height || player.y - PLAYER_RADIUS < 0) {
93:       if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
94:       playHit();
95:       player.alive = false;
96:     }
97:     // obstacles movement & spawn
98:     spawnTimer -= dt;
99:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
100:       spawnObstacle();
101:       spawnTimer = 1500; // ms until next
102:     }
103:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SPEED);
104:     // remove off‑screen obstacles
105:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
106:     // collision detection
107:     for (const o of obstacles) {
108:       const withinX = player.x + PLAYER_RADIUS > o.x && player.x - PLAYER_RADIUS < o.x + o.w;
109:       const withinY = player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS > o.y && player.y - PLAYER_RADIUS < o.y + o.h;
110:       if (withinX && withinY) {
111:         if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
112:         playHit();
113:         player.alive = false;
114:         break;
115:       }
116:     }
117:     // score based on time survived
118:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - lastTime) / 100);
119:   }
120: 
121:   function draw() {
122:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
123:     // background gradient
124:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
125:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
126:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
127:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
128:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
129:     // stars background
130:     ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
131:     // (stars drawn later)
132:     // stars – tiny flicker
133:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
134:     stars.forEach(s => {
135:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5);
136:       ctx.beginPath();
137:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
138:       ctx.fill();
139:     });
140:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
141:     // player orb – neon glow
142:     ctx.save();
143:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
144:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
145:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
146:     ctx.beginPath();
147:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
148:     ctx.fill();
149:     ctx.restore();
150:     // obstacles – neon bars with glow
151:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
152:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0f0';
153:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
154:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
155:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
156:     });
157:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
158:     // score
159:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
160:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
161:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
162:     if (!player.alive) {
163:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
164:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
165:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
166:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Click to Restart', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
167:     }
168:   }
169: 
170:   function loop(timestamp) {
171:     const dt = timestamp - (lastTime || timestamp);
172:     lastTime = timestamp;
173:     update(dt);
174:     draw();
175:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
176:   }
177: 
178:   reset();
179:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
180: })();

(End of file - total 180 lines)
</content>
